scene.initialization: One whole-scene cloud from the first selected synchronized frame: calibrated SIFT/MASt3R stereo and explicitly registered neural depth priors. No existing actor, table, older scene or later-frame geometry is merged.

tuning.selection: Choose after matched 12000-update held-out appearance and orbit checks. These holdouts become validation data after selection; do not claim an independent final test score.

refinement.optimizer_policy: Lower-rate optimizer reset at each resolution stage; reuse the selected joint whole-scene model, not independently fit frames.

production.evaluation_scope: Fit all 270 camera images after validation-based selection. Scores are fitted-reference appearance, not held-out generalization. Preserve the preceding validation-trained models.

limits: Surroundings means surfaces visible in these three recordings; unseen room surfaces are not measured.
Camera calibration away from the board and physical synchronization remain provisional until diagnostics support them.
Neural depth fills are inferred, not independent metric measurements.
Parameter and resolution selection use the temporal holdouts as validation; no independent fourth-camera test is available.
